must_catch.item: The outcome carries the online-only scope note
The decision-maker contradiction is surfaced (Maya chose, Greg decided)
Customer language is marked Not covered
"A third of the churn" is labeled unverified or opinion
Speaker 2 is treated as the AE

data.notes: The report gets the core right: a scoped 'Won' (online memberships only, front desk still with Global, phase two undated), the Maya-chose/Greg-decided contradiction, and value proof on the customer's own file as the deciding factor. Its biggest miss is the category-term finding: the 'is that the readers?' reaction to 'unified commerce' never appears as message evidence or insight, so the M3 drop is justified only by the product gap, not by the term meaning nothing to this buyer. Smaller misses: the 'members who never meant to leave' quote is missing from the trigger section; the language section lists phrases from elsewhere in the interview without saying so; and the close marks the decider and silence questions as 'dodged' even though the rep answered them.
